summary: iOS keeps unconfirmed message retries on their original member and warns before sending as new

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Unconfirmed iOS messages retain their original client and fence reader. A replaced Fabric connection stays unconfirmed rather than using another member; Resolve unconfirmed offers an explicitly approved new-key send with a duplicate warning. The new send uses the member selected when the person confirms, even if selection changed while the alert was open.

manual.detail: No migration. Sending as new is an explicit person decision and may duplicate a previously accepted message.
